scope: Individually read Japanese context and all 12 sentence/task sets. No native, metadata, device, audio or release certification.

changes.before: ប្រាប់ពិគ្រោះចូលរួម មិនធ្វើសំបុត្រដល់លក្ខខណ្ឌច្បាស់ ហើយមើលរថភ្លើងថ្មី។ សូមនិយាយជាភាសាជប៉ុន។
changes.after: ប្រាប់ថានឹងពិគ្រោះជាមួយអ្នករៀបចំប្រជុំអំពីរបៀបចូលរួម មិនធ្វើប្រតិបត្តិការលើសំបុត្ររហូតដល់បញ្ជាក់លក្ខខណ្ឌបាន ហើយក៏នឹងមើលព័ត៌មានរថភ្លើងដែលបានធ្វើបច្ចុប្បន្នភាពផងដែរ។ សូមនិយាយជាភាសាជប៉ុន។
changes.reason: Updated train display is not a new train; preserve no ticket operation until conditions confirmed.

changes.before: Bạn đang so thông tin khởi hành. Muốn hỏi giờ hay vận hành?
changes.after: Bạn đang so sánh các thông tin khởi hành phải không? Bạn muốn xác nhận giờ tàu chạy hay tình trạng vận hành?
changes.reason: Clarify timetable versus operating status in natural Vietnamese.

changes.before: Giờ dự kiến khác thực đi. Hiện chờ cập nhật giờ dự kiến. Sau đến có lịch không đổi được không?
changes.after: Giờ theo lịch và giờ khởi hành thực tế là hai việc khác nhau. Hiện chúng ta đang chờ cập nhật dự kiến khởi hành. Sau khi đến nơi, bạn có lịch hẹn nào không thể thay đổi không?
changes.reason: Distinguish scheduled time from currently pending departure estimate update.

changes.before: Loại vé khác người phụ trách, điều kiện. Có nơi mua và thứ xem vé không?
changes.after: Tùy loại vé mà nơi phụ trách và điều kiện sẽ khác nhau. Bạn có thông tin nơi mua và thứ gì có thể dùng để kiểm tra vé không?
changes.reason: Ask for purchase-source information, not possession of a purchase place.

changes.before: Chúng tôi xem hình để xác nhận nơi hỏi. Chỉ chậm không có nghĩa mọi vé xử lý như nhau.
changes.after: Tôi sẽ xem màn hình để xác nhận nơi cần liên hệ hỏi. Chỉ vì tàu chậm không có nghĩa là mọi loại vé đều được xử lý giống nhau.
changes.reason: Screen and inquiry contact are the source, not an unspecified image.

changes.before: Tôi hỏi bên họp cách dự, không thao tác vé tới khi biết điều kiện. Tàu cũng không chỉ đo giờ lịch, sẽ xem biển cập nhật.
changes.after: Tôi sẽ trao đổi với bên tổ chức cuộc họp về cách tham dự, và chưa thao tác trên vé cho đến khi biết rõ điều kiện. Tôi cũng sẽ xem thông báo tàu đã cập nhật, không chỉ dựa vào giờ theo lịch.
changes.reason: Use complete natural wording for attendance, unchanged ticket and updated status.

changes.before: 这张是手机买的。还没按取消。不假定可退就操作，想先听条件。
changes.after: 这是用手机买的车票。我还没有按取消按钮。我不会因为以为可以退款就操作，想先问清楚条件。
changes.reason: Clarify negation scope: do not operate ticket on assumption of refund.

changes.before: 這張是手機買的。還沒按取消。不假定可退就操作，想先聽條件。
changes.after: 這是用手機買的車票。我還沒有按取消按鈕。我不會因為以為可以退款就操作，想先問清楚條件。
changes.reason: Clarify negation scope: do not operate ticket on assumption of refund.

changes.before: मोबाइल खरीदी यह टिकट। रद्द बटन नहीं दबाया। वापसी मिलती मानकर नहीं छेड़ूँगा, पहले शर्त चाहिए।
changes.after: यह टिकट मैंने मोबाइल से खरीदा है। अभी तक रद्द करने का बटन नहीं दबाया है। पैसे वापस मिल जाएँगे, ऐसा मानकर कोई कार्रवाई करने के बजाय पहले शर्तें पूछना चाहता हूँ।
changes.reason: Use explicit money refund and preserve no cancel operation before checking conditions.

changes.before: স্বামীর সঙ্গে থাকা ও নিজের পরামর্শ আলাদা চাইব। আজ সব হবে না ধরে নিজের কাউন্টার ও পরের পদ্ধতি চাইব।
changes.after: স্বামীর পরামর্শে সঙ্গে থাকা এবং নিজের পরামর্শের অনুরোধ আলাদাভাবে করব। আজই সব একসঙ্গে করা যাবে, এমন ধরে না নিয়ে আমার দায়িত্বপ্রাপ্ত কাউন্টার এবং পরেরবার পরামর্শ নেওয়ার উপায় জানতে চাইব।
changes.reason: Do not assume same-day combined service; do not assert it cannot happen today.

changes.before: বুকিং স্বামীর নামে কিন্তু পারিবারিক ভেবে নিজের ঠিকানার নথিও শুনবেন ভেবেছেন জানান। জাপানি ভাষায় বলুন।
changes.after: ব্যাখ্যা করুন যে অ্যাপয়েন্টমেন্ট স্বামীর নামে, কিন্তু পারিবারিক পরামর্শ ভেবে নিজের ঠিকানার নথি সম্পর্কেও একসঙ্গে প্রশ্ন করতে পারবেন বলে ভেবেছিলেন। জাপানি ভাষায় বলুন।
changes.reason: Questioning address documents is asking, not merely listening.

changes.before: 丈夫名字。以为是家庭咨询，也能问我地址材料，一起来了。
changes.after: 是我丈夫的名字。我以为是家庭咨询，觉得也能一起问我自己的地址材料，所以就来了。
changes.reason: Do not add that husband and wife physically arrived together; source only says she came expecting a family consultation.

changes.before: 丈夫名字。以為是家庭諮詢，也能問我地址文件，一起來了。
changes.after: 是我丈夫的名字。我以為是家庭諮詢，覺得也能一起問我自己的地址文件，所以就來了。
changes.reason: Do not add that husband and wife physically arrived together; source only says she came expecting a family consultation.

changes.before: Kontak panduan alamat ini tidak terbaca, jadi tidak tahu loket mana. Sebelum memakai waktu suami, tolong beri tahu petugas lain.
changes.after: Saya tidak bisa membaca informasi kontak pada panduan alamat ini, jadi tidak tahu harus ke loket mana. Sebelum menggunakan waktu konsultasi suami, saya ingin diberi tahu petugas lain yang bertanggung jawab.
changes.reason: Learner cannot read contact details; source does not assert the document itself is illegible.

changes.before: Xem hướng dẫn rồi tìm nơi. Nếu cần hỗ trợ lời nói cũng nghe mong muốn.
changes.after: Tôi sẽ xem bản hướng dẫn để tìm nơi tư vấn phù hợp. Nếu bạn cần hỗ trợ ngôn ngữ, bạn cũng có thể cho biết mong muốn của mình.
changes.reason: 言葉の支援 refers to language assistance, not only spoken help.

changes.before: I will request attending my husband's consultation separately from my own. I will not assume both can be done today, and will ask my counter and next consultation methods.
changes.after: I will request permission to attend my husband's consultation and ask for my own consultation separately. I will not assume both can be handled together today; I will ask which counter is responsible for my matter and how I can arrange the next consultation.
changes.reason: Use clear counter responsibility and future consultation method rather than ask my counter.

changes.before: Muốn nộp giấy trả tiền cho công ty nhưng không biết trong hai tờ này đâu là hóa đơn.
changes.after: Tôi muốn nộp giấy tờ chứng minh thanh toán cho nơi làm việc, nhưng không biết trong hai tờ đã nhận này, tờ nào là biên lai thanh toán.
changes.reason: Distinguish payment receipt from medical itemization and appointment slip.

changes.before: Hỏi trong hai tờ đã nhận đâu là hóa đơn để nộp giấy thanh toán nơi làm. Hãy nói bằng tiếng Nhật.
changes.after: Để nộp giấy tờ thanh toán cho nơi làm việc, hãy hỏi trong hai tờ đã nhận, tờ nào là biên lai thanh toán. Hãy nói bằng tiếng Nhật.
changes.reason: Use clear receipt terminology in payment-proof task.

changes.before: Đây là chi tiết khám, kia là phiếu hẹn tới. Ta hỏi thu ngân có hóa đơn riêng không.
changes.after: Tôi xem thì tờ này là bảng kê chi tiết khám chữa bệnh, còn tờ kia là phiếu hẹn lần tới. Chúng ta hãy hỏi bộ phận thu ngân xem có biên lai thanh toán riêng không.
changes.reason: Differentiate the three documents explicitly.

changes.before: Chưa quyết chưa nhận hay nhận không thấy, sẽ truyền nguyên vậy. Bạn giải thích cách trả được không?
changes.after: Tôi sẽ truyền đạt đúng tình hình, chưa kết luận là bạn chưa nhận hay đã nhận nhưng hiện không tìm thấy. Bạn có thể cho biết đã thanh toán bằng cách nào không?
changes.reason: Preserve uncertainty instead of deciding nonreceipt versus loss.

changes.before: Chỉ nói thứ thấy thanh toán, chưa hỏi gốc. Riêng với xác nhận công ty, muốn nhờ tra tình trạng cấp hóa đơn.
changes.after: Nơi làm việc chỉ nói cần giấy tờ chứng minh đã thanh toán, còn có cần bản gốc không thì tôi chưa hỏi. Ngoài việc xác nhận với nơi làm việc, tôi muốn nhờ kiểm tra xem biên lai thanh toán đã được cấp hay chưa.
changes.reason: Separate workplace original requirement from billing issuance check.

changes.before: Nói chưa rõ công ty yêu cầu gốc, nhờ hỏi riêng tình trạng cấp hóa đơn. Hãy nói bằng tiếng Nhật.
changes.after: Nói rằng bạn chưa xác nhận nơi làm việc có yêu cầu bản gốc hay không, và nhờ kiểm tra riêng tình trạng cấp biên lai thanh toán. Hãy nói bằng tiếng Nhật.
changes.reason: Use explicit receipt issuance and unconfirmed original requirement.

changes.before: Ta tách hai xác nhận. Hiện tôi cũng không quyết có cấp lại được, cần phí không.
changes.after: Chúng ta hãy tách riêng hai việc cần xác nhận. Hiện tôi cũng chưa thể khẳng định có thể cấp lại hay không và có mất phí hay không.
changes.reason: Reissue possibility and fee are both unconfirmed.

changes.before: We will relay that without deciding whether it was never received or was received and lost. Can you describe your payment method?
changes.after: We will relay the situation as it is, without deciding whether you did not receive it or received it but cannot find it now. Can you describe how you paid?
changes.reason: 見当たらない is cannot find, not established loss; preserve deliberate uncertainty.

changes.before: Kami sampaikan tanpa menentukan belum diterima atau sudah diterima lalu hilang. Bisa jelaskan metode bayar?
changes.after: Kami akan menyampaikan keadaan apa adanya, tanpa memutuskan apakah Anda belum menerimanya atau sudah menerimanya tetapi sekarang tidak dapat menemukannya. Bisakah Anda menjelaskan cara pembayarannya?
changes.reason: Do not strengthen cannot find into established loss.

changes.before: ပေးငွေသိရာပဲပြောပြီးမူရင်းမမေးပါဘူး။ အလုပ်စစ်တာနဲ့ခွဲပြီးဘောင်ချာထုတ်အခြေအနေစစ်ပေးချင်ပါတယ်။
changes.after: ငွေပေးချေထားကြောင်း သိနိုင်သော စာရွက်ဟုသာ ပြောထားပြီး မူရင်းလိုမလို မမေးရသေးပါဘူး။ အလုပ်ဌာနကို အတည်ပြုမေးမြန်းတာနဲ့ သီးခြားအနေနဲ့ ဘောင်ချာထုတ်ပေးထားပြီးလားဆိုတာ စစ်ဆေးပေးစေချင်ပါတယ်။
changes.reason: Correct request direction: learner wants staff to investigate issuance, not offers to inspect for staff.

changes.before: অফিসে পেমেন্ট কাগজ চাই কিন্তু পাওয়া দুটির কোনটি রসিদ জানি না।
changes.after: কর্মস্থলে টাকা দেওয়ার প্রমাণপত্র জমা দিতে চাই, কিন্তু পাওয়া এই দুটি কাগজের কোনটি রসিদ, তা জানি না।
changes.reason: Learner wants to submit payment proof; not that office is asking in this turn.

changes.before: পাননি না পেয়ে হারিয়েছে এখন না ধরে বলব। দেওয়ার পদ্ধতি বলবেন?
changes.after: পাননি, নাকি পেয়েছিলেন কিন্তু এখন খুঁজে পাচ্ছেন না—এখনই কোনো সিদ্ধান্ত না নিয়ে পরিস্থিতি যেমন আছে তেমনই জানাব। কীভাবে টাকা দিয়েছেন তা বলতে পারবেন?
changes.reason: Keep uncertainty between nonreceipt and inability to find, not established loss.

reviewCriteria.note: Read all 11 Japanese turns, five Japanese task hints and all 192 target fields; preserved unverified notice, use of known contact, no transfer before verification, separate bank fee/rent responsibility, and deferral today. Repaired account-holder vs bank-name drift and two Khmer/Burmese action/term errors.

Read Japanese source and all 12 complete target sets; checked only two workplace cleaning products, separate food checkout, own bag versus paid separate bag, cash/card acceptance, receipt name and payment after both checkouts prepared. Repaired Hindi/Tagalog actor and Bengali timing ambiguity; smoothed Vietnamese translations and five prompts.

Read Japanese and all 192 targets; checked sign one-way versus whole round trip, fatigue/early return priority, no guaranteed seat, turnaround landmark, option to return before landmark and spare energy. Clarified former/new misconception chronology in Hindi/Bengali and unambiguous English round trip; improved Vietnamese priority and Bengali near-entrance/seat condition.

Read Japanese context and all 12 complete sets. Checked schedule versus actual departure, pending update, meeting online participation requires permission, no guaranteed station connection/call place, no new ticket before reply, cancellation untouched and refund varies by ticket. Repaired Khmer new-train drift, refund-negation wording and Vietnamese inquiry context.

Read Japanese and all 192 translated fields. Checked husband-named appointment versus wife separate address matter, accompanying not automatic separate consultation, identify other desk before using husband time, short-sentence language support, same-day availability not guaranteed and documents kept separate. Repaired Bengali negation scope and added joint-arrival assumption in Chinese.

Read Japanese and all 192 fields; checked treatment breakdown and next appointment slip are distinct from receipt, receipt issuance/receipt receipt history uncertain, cash and approximate time only, no self-written paid substitute, separate workplace-original and billing-status inquiries, reissue/fee unconfirmed and retain both sheets. Repaired Burmese request direction, uncertainty strengthening and Vietnamese document terminology.

storage: Additive receipt; previous receipt files retained byte-for-byte.
